name: Büsingen am Hochrhein (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and blue, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Büsingen am Hochrhein (a bunch of grapes with leaves on red).
history: Municipal flag of Büsingen am Hochrhein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Büsingen am Hochrhein arms — grapes on red
